description: This file implements a class 'WidevinePlatformDRM' that interfaces with Widevine DRM functionalities, including constructing the platform object, deinitializing it, and decrypting data using handle-based and session-based methods. It interacts with external components such as the 'widevine::Cdm' class and utilities like 'avbConvertHandleToSecurePointer'.
